test_Connection_send: test the Connection class send method by creating a mock channel and sending a CreateWorldRequest
test_Connection_close: test that sending a request after calling close on Connection raises a ValueError
test_Connection_error: test that Connection.send raises DmEnvRpcError when the server returns an error response
test_create_secure_channel_and_connect: test create_secure_channel_and_connect to verify it creates a gRPC secure channel and waits for readiness
test_Connection_extension: test sending a packed Any protobuf extension request through Connection and verifying the response
